page.overview:
Who is Monica Alvarez?

Monica is one of several protagonists of the IDW Publishing comic series Jurassic Park: The Devils in the Desert.

Monica Alvarez was born Monica Ramirez to Dr. Jorge Ramirez and an unknown woman. Like her father, Monica pursued working in the field of paleontology - the study of prehistoric lifeforms such as dinosaurs. Monica would become an expert in her field and work alongside her father at a California State University.

At some point before 2008, Monica met and married a Steven Alvarez and took his last name. Alvarez was an engineer and part of the United States Armed Forces in Afghanistan. According to Monica, Steven was uninterested in her field. For eighteen months (from 2007-2008) Steven had stayed in an unnamed Afghan village helping to improve the infrastructure of the area. Even building a school, a hospital, and improving the road network. The village however didn't tell the Americans about a bomb buried by the Taliban and let it detonate, killing Steven and six other American G.I.'s.

Even three years after his passing Monica kept Steven's surname.
